description: Register a CRM agent with its allowed change types and daily token cap. Every agent starts in `propose`; `shadow` is not a mode. Requires `approve` scope and a company Owner.

agentId.description: The service-account id the agent files proposals as.

dailyTokenCap.description: Tokens the agent may spend per day.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

name: anyforge_register_crm_agent
title: Register crm agent
